title: India October inflation tops RBI's 6% limit, strengthens case for rate hikes
summary: NEW DELHI: India’s retail inflation surged in October to 6.09%, breaching the central bank’s upper tolerance limit for the first time under the new series, as rising food prices drove up household costs and bolstered bets of further rate hikes.
